cluster_method.feature_set: five 2023 mean monthly category/all ratios; StandardScaler on 2023 only
cluster_method.use: descriptive exposure profiles, not presumed economic types

matching_features: slope of log all-spending2023 per month
comparison.exposure: unknown; outside 3 selected regions does not prove absence of shocks
comparison.if_insufficient: NO_MATCH_SUPPORT; no relaxing calipers after outcomes

primary_outcome: April model residual percent, all five nonaggregate categories reported; aggregate separate
relative_comparison: anchor residual minus median of selected comparisons; no causal effect label

recovery.rule: first pair of consecutive months May-Dec with abs(residual)<=10%; if April not below -10%, NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_INITIAL_DROP
recovery.interpretation: model-defined normalization, not proven economic recovery

placebo.use: two limited pre-event descriptive diagnostics; not independent replicates

uncertainty: no general-population significance or CI from three related selected cases; comparison spread shown descriptively
prior_access: all case outcomes and R9 models previously viewed; this is not preregistration or unseen holdout
external_validation: reuse reported KB75/16427 A8 2025, audit provenance; no retuning clusters to obtain significance
checks: mutating all future values changes neither features/labels/peers nor forecasts
limits: Atlas panel membership was defined using 2023-2024 completeness; retrospective selection, not historical online population
dictionary current snapshot/native keys; no new official boundary-successorship proof
Only three previously viewed cities from a shared flood family; no pooled causal inference
No causal interpretation of comparison residual gap or regional network transmission
Failure to reenter forecast band by December is RIGHT_CENSORED, not permanent loss
